The earlier a020944 exact-row, adapter and acceptance coverage claims are superseded claims; the round-three production-entry assertions are author evidence, not independent closure.

The immediate lstat-plus-rename sequence detects observed occupancy but does not prove kernel-atomic no-replace behavior; collision handling remains conservative and Android physical proof is still gated.
